description: Fused-cast MXFP8 GEMM: bits against per_token_cast + gemm_mxfp8 and time per call (B6 and WO-B shapes); then WO-B decode tiles against today's path.
argv: import subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/check_gemm_cast.py', '--time']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/sweep_fp8_decode.py'])]; print('exit codes', codes); print(f'{2 - sum(1 for c in codes if c)} passed'); sys.exit(max(codes))
